validation_design.execution_assumption: D1/H4 execution only if later authorized; Stage64G uses feature dates only and no orders.

cost_assumption_bps.note: Design placeholder only; Stage64H must apply fixed costs before scoring. No trading is authorized.

splits.design_note: Must not be used for parameter search.
Recent split, but ETF/central-bank features are excluded in reduced scope.

pass_criteria: Candidate must beat always-long and gold-trend-only benchmarks after fixed cost overall.
Candidate must not rely on a single split; pass requires improvement in at least 3 of 4 splits.
Candidate must not create excessive signal concentration in the recent split.
Candidate must survive familywise correction over candidate hypotheses and horizons.
kill_criteria: Kill if candidate underperforms always-long after costs overall.
Kill if candidate has negative mean in two or more splits.
Kill if the only positive result is 2023_present or any single split.
Kill if conclusions depend on changing horizons, thresholds, or filters after seeing results.
